class.name: CgameEarlyReflections
class.brief_description: Image-source early reflections for shoebox rooms and impulse response synthesis.
class.description: Static helpers that compute early reflections of a rectangular room with the image-source method (J. B. Allen and D. A. Berkley, "Image method for efficiently simulating small-room acoustics", JASA 1979) and turn reflection lists into impulse responses suitable for [AudioEffectConvolutionReverb]. A reflection is a [Dictionary] with the keys [code]delay_s[/code] ([float]), [code]gain[/code] ([float]), [code]direction[/code] ([Vector3], unit vector from the listener towards the image source), [code]order[/code] ([int], number of wall bounces, [code]0[/code] is the direct sound) and [code]distance[/code] ([float]). All methods are deterministic: equal inputs and seeds give identical results.

method.name: echogram_to_reflections
method.description: Converts an energy histogram (echogram) with bins of [param bin_s] seconds into reflection dictionaries. The gain of a bin is the square root of its energy and its delay is at the bin center. Empty bins are skipped.

method.name: image_source_count
method.description: Returns the number of image sources, including the direct path, produced by [method image_sources_box] for the given [param order]. Equal to [code]1[/code], [code]7[/code], [code]25[/code] for orders 0, 1 and 2.

method.name: image_sources_box
method.description: Computes the image sources of the box [code]0..room_size[/code] for a [param source] and [param listener] inside it, up to [param order] total wall bounces (clamped to 32). Each wall bounce scales the amplitude by [code]sqrt(1 - absorption)[/code]; the gain also includes [code]1 / distance[/code] spreading with a minimum distance of 0.1. The result is sorted by delay; [param speed] is the speed of sound in meters per second.

method.name: impulse_response
method.description: Synthesizes a diffuse reverb tail: noise split into three bands, each decaying by 60 dB over its own reverberation time ([code]x[/code] low, [code]y[/code] mid, [code]z[/code] high, in seconds). The result is peak-normalized to 1.

method.name: to_ir
method.description: Builds a mono impulse response of exactly [code]sample_rate * length_s[/code] samples: the reflections are written as linearly interpolated (fractionally delayed) impulses, normalized, and mixed with the tail from [method impulse_response], which fades in quadratically over [param late_start_s] and is scaled by [param late_gain]. The result is peak-normalized to 1.
